findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false. Automatic annual rotation of the key material is disabled, so a compromised key encrypts data indefinitely and cryptoperiod requirements for audit data are not met.

No policy argument is specified, so AWS applies the default key policy that delegates full key access to the account root, allowing any IAM principal in the account with sufficient IAM permissions to use or administer the key. For a key protecting audit trail data this fails least privilege and permits a key administrator to disable or delete the key, destroying audit evidence.
